scope: Native Forma public Document binding sync allocation volume, not Svet graph or renderer throughput

host.profile: release, vector-ui profile codegen-units1 / fat LTO

retained_change: borrow collection data for presence/inspection instead of cloning entire lists
refuse resolver collections over16384 items before constructing key scan context
rejected_change: Per-transaction key index cache removed: initial A/B did not show a stable latency gain and small cases regressed

performance.workload: 8/32/96 text editors, seven alternating noop/one-edit samples per fresh process
performance.phase1: uninstrumented old vs cached; raw native-binding-sync-A*/B* and analysis retained
performance.phase2: isolated clone reference vs retained borrowed version, same counting allocator/harness; R1,C1,R2,C2
performance.latency: No reliable speedup. Latest instrumented96 one-edit ratios C1/R1=1.004 and C2/R2=1.076; possible latency regression remains open. Counters matched exactly between repeat runs.
performance.remaining_cost: About110 MB cumulative allocation requests per96-editor sync remains excessive; shared scope/state representation and preflight work need profiling/redesign.

limitations: counted calling-thread requested bytes, not live/peak memory/RSS
same allocator instrumentation in both variants; timings include instrumentation overhead
existing immutable HTTP natural-GC soak and other host activity continued; quiet-host timing qualification remains open
no application frame-time, GPU, browser or remote-CI performance claim
root rendering/state/scope copies still scale poorly; this does not close P3
